keySentence: She always found something good because kindness was her nature.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The whole town started changing. People became kinder. It was because of Pollyanna. She always found something good because kindness was her nature.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The glad game spread through the whole town like magic. The baker started sharing bread with his neighbors. The doctor treated sick people for free with a kind smile. She always found something good because kindness was her nature. People learned to look for the bright side from Pollyanna. The whole town became a warmer and happier place.
